messages:
devin: Heads up — EU warm pool failures after the ephemeral KMS routing change at 07:05. GPU join latencies spiked.
marie: seeing this too, logs show keystore-proxy queueing and natgw conntrack jumps :grimacing:
alejandro: what changed in routing? I thought we only updated the audit sink TTL
samira: new auditfold endpoint got deployed, it added an extra auth header check which causes backpressure on the keystore-proxy
devin: exact, keystore-proxy started retrying -> pushes into natgw bursts -> conntrack exhaustion -> warmup failures
sre-bot: Alert: keystore-proxy p50 latency > 1200ms, p95 > 2s in EU (07:06)
ops: rolling back auditfold routing now (starting)
marie: +1, can we canary the routing for 1% traffic and add a fail-open for ephemeral keys? We need minimal impact on GPU warmup
alejandro: rollback in progress, ETA ~3m
samira: quick mitigation idea: add an egress allowlist for the auditfold IPs to bypass the proxy path (temp)
devin: tradeoff: bypassing proxy increases audit sampling costs and bypasses some proxy-side auth checks — but helps warmups
ops: rollback complete, looks like warmups are recovering (baseline join latency improving)
marie: warmup success rate back to 98% over the last 5m, token queueing dropping
alejandro: follow-ups: gate full rollout with a canary, add IAM role restriction on the new audit principal, and implement a keystore circuit-breaker to avoid retry storms
samira: I'll open a runbook PR documenting the remediation steps + commands for oncall
devin: candidate quick commands to run if we need the temp allowlist:
```bash
# temp allowlist auditfold to bypass keystore-proxy
kubectl -n infra patch configmap keystore-egress --patch '{"data":{"egress_allowlist":"auditfold-eu:443"}}'
# apply circuit breaker for keystore-proxy
kubectl -n infra apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: keystore-circuit-breaker
data:
  failure_threshold: "5"
  window_seconds: "30"
EOF
```
marie: also need to measure NAT GW conntrack and egress cost delta, file follow-up for billing impact
ops-runbook-bot: Created incident 2026-03-23-001 and assigned to oncall (ops); runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ephemeral-kms-routing
samira: filing ticket: INFRA-8472 (canary + IAM boundary + circuit-breaker)
devin: thumbs up. keep audit routing disabled in EU until canary + CB in place
marie: :thumbsup:
